mechanism.claim: An unusually large change in average equity volatility relative to average commodity volatility isolates financial-risk repricing. In high BTC variation, BTC follows the sign of equity-minus-commodity volatility risk for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: short when the equity-minus-commodity change residual is strictly positive; long when strictly negative
mechanism.why_distinct: CAVBR-12 uses sign breadth and ECVDR-12 requires opposite confirmed pairs; both are terminal. ECVRS uses a continuous equal-weight four-index residual and its own strict-prior absolute-residual rank, with no sign-pair requirement or prior control promotion.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized-variation rank must be at least 0.65 and absolute residual rank at least 0.70
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official next-Cboe-session 09:35 ET entries have previously shown low Gross9 structural overlap

features.common_source_dates: exact intersection of positive finite daily closes for VIX,VXN,GVZ,OVX
features.absolute_residual_rank: strict-prior midrank at most 252 prior valid source dates; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.availability: source-date residual usable at 09:30 America/New_York on next exact common Cboe source date
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over exact BTCUSDT 1m rows in prior 24 elapsed hours
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank at most 252 prior valid decisions; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: next exact common Cboe source date 09:30 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent continuous equity-versus-commodity volatility residual mechanism plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no residual, rank, clock, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
